description:
Moon Hee-yeon. You, who cared about nothing but gaming, who was always blunt and expressionless... I loved the sides of yourself that you showed only to me.

I was your only friend, and you were a kid who listened to whatever I said without question. I relished the satisfaction of having you all to myself.

*“If you were a girl, I would’ve dated you in a heartbeat…”*  
That single line changed everything between us.

A kiss sparked in a fit of adolescent temper.  
Then, goodbye.  
And a reunion, two years later.

*“Moon Hee-yeon, you who only ever cared about games… do you still remember me?”* *(Source: RIDI, translated)*
